runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 21:29 public-web sweep across 14 actually searched source families. Strongest new candidate is Ovečkárna seasonal CZ/SK customer-support brigade: direct company career page confirms work from anywhere, IČO/DPP, Mon-Fri 08:00-12:00, email/customer-line support, simple order administration, no experience required and training provided; Práca za rohom/Prace.cz show 160 CZK/h and 1.10.2026-31.1.2027. It is remote-ok in substance, but jobs-data.json could not be safely full-replaced in this run without risking unrelated LIVE data, so it remains promotion-ready rather than persisted. Bratislavské kultúrne a informačné stredisko surfaced a same-day technical-support section assistant at Vajnorská 135, Bratislava, from 1,400 EUR with Slovak only; retained as a high-value verification candidate. Práca za rohom also surfaced an autoprevádzka/vodič referent in Bratislava and Orange fleet-admin role, but the latter needs intermediate English. LinkedIn surfaced current Slovakia support inventory but most concrete roles had foreign-language or specialist requirements. Upwork fresh public hits were rejected for hard-development scope, strong written English, suspicious economics or weak client trust. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Remote contract legality gate
developmentChanges.reason: For foreign remote jobs that say work from anywhere, record whether the offered contract form can actually be used from Slovakia (for example IČO/B2B vs local-only DPP). This prevents a good remote job from being promoted on geography alone when the legal engagement model may not work cross-border.

developmentChanges.title: Part-time stackability score
developmentChanges.reason: Score short fixed daily windows by how well they can be combined with another job or KomArena work. A predictable Mon-Fri 08:00-12:00 remote block should rank differently from an equally paid role with rotating or fragmented shifts, improving total monthly-income planning.
